algorithm: build APMA typed mosaic and connected native modules
reject variables shared by more than two modules
construct canonical lexicographic spanning forest of the module interaction graph
define cotree edge set E\T and cutset C as the union of exact shared-variable sets on cotree edges
enumerate only the certified cutset assignments
condition every native module on the cutset assignment
verify that the conditioned interaction is a forest
run the already sealed exact module-forest message solver
SAT if any cutset branch returns a checked witness; UNSAT only if every branch returns certified UNSAT
